summary: Iteration 131: Prelaunch Tier 3 (Extended Order Lifecycle sections 3.1-3.10) + Tier 4 (People & Portals sections 4.1-4.5). 52/55 tests passed (94.5%), 3 skipped due to unimplemented endpoints. All major flows working. Key API gaps documented below.

minor.issue: 3.6-A/B: Appointment CREATE and LIST endpoints are NOT implemented. The /api/appointments router only has GET /{appointment_id} (detail view). No POST to create, no GET list, no PUT reschedule, no DELETE cancel. Tests skipped.
3.10-C: Invoice aging endpoint is NOT implemented. The financials_router has /summary, /sales, /expenses but no /invoice-aging. Test skipped.

3.5-D/E: Admin-side ProofUpdate model does NOT include a status field. Admin cannot change proof status (approve/reject/request_changes) via PUT /api/approvals/{id}. Status changes are only possible from the customer portal side (/api/portal/proofs/{id}/respond). Checklist items 3.5-D and 3.5-E partially tested — description update works, but status change is customer-only.

3.5-A: Checklist describes fields {order_id, title, proof_url, requires_approval} but actual ProofCreate model uses {job_id, file_url, file_name} (no title or requires_approval). The field 'job_id' doubles as order_id (API checks both orders and jobs collections). Works but field names differ from checklist spec.

action_items: MISSING 3.6: Appointment CRUD is NOT implemented. Only GET /{id} exists. Need: POST /api/appointments (create), GET /api/appointments (list), PUT /api/appointments/{id} (update/reschedule), DELETE /api/appointments/{id} or PUT with status=cancelled. The dashboard customer portal already queries appointments — they need a management endpoint for the admin side.

MISSING 3.10-C: Invoice aging endpoint GET /api/financials/invoice-aging is not implemented. Consider adding a route that groups outstanding invoices into buckets: 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days overdue.

DESIGN 3.5: Admin ProofUpdate model (PUT /api/approvals/{id}) lacks status field. Admin can only update description/file_url/thumbnail_url/watermarked_url. To change proof status (approve/reject/request_changes) admin needs their own endpoint or status must be added to ProofUpdate. Currently status changes are only possible from customer portal side.

CHECKLIST NOTE 3.5-A: Checklist describes POST /api/approvals with {order_id, title, proof_url, requires_approval} but actual API expects {job_id, file_url, file_name}. Checklist should be updated to reflect actual field names.
CHECKLIST NOTE 3.4: Checklist describes workflow-template POST with {name, steps} but actual model uses {category, template_name, stages}. Checklist should be updated.
CHECKLIST NOTE 3.10-A: Checklist asks for GET /api/financials → returns {revenue, expenses, profit} but correct endpoint is GET /api/financials/summary. No base /financials route exists.

PORTAL NOTE 4.4: test_credentials.md lists dklayb@gmail.com as Customer Portal Test Account but this customer does NOT exist in the production database. The portal registration returns 'No customer account found'. Used taxtest_non@example.com (customer 1eaeec1d) instead for 4.4 tests. Update test_credentials.md.
critical_code_review_comments: HIGH: Appointment CRUD is completely missing. The appointments collection is referenced by portal dashboard and customer portal queries, but admin-side create/update/delete/list endpoints are absent. This is a significant functional gap for the sign-shop workflow.

MEDIUM: ProofUpdate model doesn't include status field — admin cannot approve/reject proofs from the admin API. Only customer portal can change proof status. This creates an asymmetry where admins must act as customers to change approval status.

LOW: Invoice aging data not exposed via API. This is a useful financial metric for tracking AR receivables (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ day buckets). The data exists in invoices collection but no endpoint aggregates it.
LOW: /api/financials base endpoint doesn't exist — only /financials/summary, /financials/expenses, /financials/sales. Checklist references GET /api/financials which may cause frontend confusion.
INFO: test_credentials.md customer portal entry (dklayb@gmail.com) is stale — that customer doesn't exist in production DB. Should be updated to reflect a valid customer.
